wording: Rendered, not simulated: every particle's position is a closed-form function of its 64-bit key and time. Nothing is stored per particle between frames. evaluated = particles the GPU ran through the kernel this frame; landed = those whose position fell inside the picture. Under count weighting each landed particle adds exactly one unit of light (checked per frame: unitSum = landed x 65536 for point splats). Under flux weighting a far particle's weight is randomly rounded and often 0, so it is landed but drawn only in expectation.

source.entry: Chrome 157 via playwright-core, src/offline/core renderJob + gradeJob (contrast 256), composition B from the GPU-test thread's offline.mjs compose mode

drawing.meaning: flux: weights randomly rounded (unbiased); far particles are drawn on average, many add nothing
